ContextMenu_Lootbox_CreditDegrade: Card has a %1% chance of degrading on use.
ContextMenu_Lootbox_Open_Type: Open Max Same Category Lootboxes [ x%1 ] [ %2 ]
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_BatchFiveDiscou: Determines what percentage of money is taken off for a batch of 5 lootboxes. Rounds down.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_BatchTenDiscoun: Determines what percentage of money is taken off for a batch of 10 lootboxes. Rounds down.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_CardIncr_toolti: After a successful clean purchase, how much more likely it is for a card to use up durability when purchasing.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_CardUses_toolti: How many uses (how much durability) a card has before it's rendered useless.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_CreditCards_too: Preserves credit cards in the regular loot tables. Credit cards can be used for one free maximum bulk purchase.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_GeneralLoot_too: When enabled, ignores the category system usually used by the mod, so any lootbox can give any item.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_KillReward_tool: Determines how much money is earned from a kill. Ignored if cost is 0.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_RandomCatImprov: Uses an improved randomization system to make it so categories will less items are less likely to show up.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_RandomCat_toolt: When enabled, randomizes the category of the lootbox during conversion. Ignored if Generalized Lootboxes is enabled.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_RandomFluid_too: Determines if liquid containers have their contents randomized.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_RandomSpoil_too: Determines if food freshness is randomized.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_SprinterBonus_t: Determines how much additional cash is rewarded if a sprinter is killed. (Still applies even while all zombies are set to Sprinters)
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_UnlockCost_tool: Determines how much money it takes to unlock a lootbox. Set to 0 for free unlocks.
Sandbox_LootboxChallenge_UpdateTick_tool: Determines how many tiles update per tick. Higher numbers may lag or crash the game, however lower numbers will result in slower conversions.
Tooltip_RandomLootboxItem: Pop this sucker open for a random item within the specified category!
